source_text: Nos autem revelata facie gloriam Domini speculantes transformamur. Non Moyses solus; Spiritus libertatis.
pass_a_gloss: We however with-unveiled face glory of-Lord beholding are-transformed. Not Moses alone; Spirit of-liberty.
pass_b_english: [[We with unveiled face, beholding the Lord’s glory, are transformed >> Bible:2 Corinthians 3:18]]. Not Moses alone — where the Spirit is, there is liberty.
